context: Tests whether the agent handles a complex skill with many workflow steps, references, and scripts by producing diverse scenarios that cover different workflow phases

checklist.name: covers-multiple-workflow-phases
checklist.description: Scenarios collectively test at least 3 different phases of the 7-step workflow (not all testing the same phase)

checklist.name: weights-sum-to-100
checklist.description: Every criteria.json has checklist weights that sum to exactly 100

checklist.name: complexity-variation
checklist.description: At least one simple scenario and one challenging scenario with multiple interacting concerns

checklist.name: input-fixtures-realistic
checklist.description: Input fixtures resemble real project artifacts (Dockerfiles, CI configs, deploy scripts) rather than toy examples

checklist.name: criteria-specificity
checklist.description: All checklist criteria describe observable, binary-verifiable behaviors without subjective language

checklist.name: task-self-contained
checklist.description: Each task.md is understandable without reading the skill definition — provides enough context inline

checklist.name: task-no-skill-reference
checklist.description: No task.md mentions the deploy-service skill by name or hints at which behaviors are being tested

checklist.name: scenario-json-include-field
checklist.description: Scenario directories with input fixtures have include field in scenario.json; those without do not
